svg.aria-label: Amoura Florals. Online storefront for an Orlando florist, with an admin dashboard and Stripe checkout. Stack: JavaScript, Node.js, Supabase, Stripe. Security: Signed Stripe webhooks, server-side admin role checks, secrets kept off the client.
